# Hashed pins for the packages the application image installs (the API, the
# ontology package, and their transitive dependencies). The Dockerfile installs
# this file with --require-hashes, then the two editable trees with --no-deps,
# because an editable install cannot itself be hash-checked. constraints.txt
# still pins the versions: a constraints file takes no hashes (pip does not
# apply them there).
#
# Every file PyPI published for each pin is listed (wheels and sdists, every
# platform), so the same lock resolves on the architectures the image builds
# on. Hashes were read from each file's digests.sha256 on the PyPI JSON API.
# yara-x stays in requirements-yara.txt; the telegram extra's packages stay in
# requirements-telegram.txt.
#
# To regenerate: walk the declared dependencies against this constraints.txt,
# read https://pypi.org/pypi/<name>/<version>/json, and take every unyanked
# file's sha256.
